value.rationale: Noncrossing set partitions are a classical Catalan family closed under deletion of ground-set points. Exact zero-error recoverability for an unknown deleted point has its own combinatorial incidence geometry, not determined by Catalan counting. The order-five fractional integrality onset and order-six integer-rounding failure are sharp natural cutoffs and a useful finite benchmark for deletion-packing relaxations. Neither code reproduction nor the bare LP method is claimed as the value.
